Statement: High and Critical severity tickets receive an initial response within the documented SLA window.
TestabilityNotes: Measure via ticketing-system timestamp delta from ticket creation to first agent response (claim/comment); 4h = 240 minutes.

Statement: Triage outcome taxonomy stays bounded to a small closed set so agents can apply outcomes consistently.
TestabilityNotes: Spot-check randomly sampled tickets monthly: every closed ticket carries one of the four documented outcomes (resolved / escalated / duplicate / billing). Drift outside the set indicates an unsanctioned outcome being introduced.
Notes: Qualitative NFR per INV-09 (usability category may omit Metric+Target if TestabilityNotes is non-empty)
